title: Residential Lot Villa Libertad
description: Own a prime 500 sqm titled property in Villa Libertad, El Nido, Palawan. Perfect for  villa, vacation home, or income-generating rental property, this strategically located lot is only minutes from Lio Beach and Lio Tourism Estate. Surrounded by nature and thriving tourism developments, this property offers strong investment potential in one of the Philippines' most sought-after island destinations.
highlights: Titled Property – Secure ownership with a clean individual title.
Strategic Location – Situated in Villa Libertad, one of El Nido's fastest-growing residential and tourism areas.
Near Lio Tourism Estate – Just a short drive (approximately 5–10 minutes) to Lio Beach and the world-class Lio Tourism Estate, home to restaurants, cafes, shops, resorts, and recreational facilities.
Ideal for Villa Development – The 500 sqm lot provides ample space for a private pool, landscaped gardens, guest accommodations, and outdoor entertainment areas.
